title: 22 Couples Wired Up: Why Holding Hands Cuts Pain on Scans
topic: Why Holding a Partner Hand Synchronizes Brain Waves and Cuts Pain
act5_climax_episode: In 2018 in PNAS, Pavel Goldstein and Simone Shamay-Tsoory wired 22 romantic couples into dual-EEG hyperscanning during forearm heat pain — proving skin-to-skin handholding locks 8-to-12 Hz brain waves together in direct proportion to pain relief.
